subject: Final MAP & signoff window for pilot + start date
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jill Thompson <jill.thompson@acmeretail.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Final MAP & signoff window for pilot + start date

Hi Jill / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for the productive evaluation cycle. Per our conversations, attached is the latest mutual action plan (MAP_v3.pdf) and the redlined SOW (SOW_Redwood_v1.3.docx). Key items:

- Evaluation acceptance criteria: feature parity checklist + performance targets (see MAP, section 3).
- Deliverables for pilot: dedicated infra, access to console dashboards, onboarding playbook.
- Proposed signature window: Nov 8–10 (we can extend a day if needed).
- Target start date: Nov 15, subject to final paperwork and access provisioning.

Can you confirm whether procurement will be able to provide a go/no-go decision by EOD Nov 5? If that timeline is tight, suggest we move the sign window to Nov 10–12 and shift the start to Nov 22.

Attachments: MAP_v3.pdf (MAP), SOW_Redwood_v1.3.docx (SOW draft).

Next steps I propose:
1) Your team confirms acceptance criteria and any required redlines to SOW.
2) I push the DocuSign envelope and loop legal if there are contractual changes.
3) We lock a start date once PO/signature is received.

Let me know the preferred timing — happy to jump on a quick call to run through the MAP and acceptance gates.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

[attachment: MAP_v3.pdf (PDF, 327 KB)]
[attachment: SOW_Redwood_v1.3.docx (DOCX, 112 KB)]

From: Jill Thompson <jill.thompson@acmeretail.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeretail.com>, Acme Retail Legal <legal@acmeretail.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T13:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Final MAP & signoff window for pilot + start date

Dylan — thanks for the materials and the clear timeline. We reviewed the MAP and have two immediate asks from procurement/legal before committing to a sign window:

1) One-page SOC2 / data handling summary for our procurement file (they often require a simple PDF).
2) Clarification on billing: is monthly invoicing acceptable for a pilot or do you require a commitment invoice upfront?

We are targeting an internal decision meeting on Nov 5 but our legal team may want to apply a few standard redlines to the SOW (mostly around liability caps and data CTAs). If you can provide the SOC2 summary and indicate billing flexibility, I can push this through.

Also — would you accept a signed PO in lieu of an immediate signature on the SOW? That would speed procurement on our side.

-Jill
Jill Thompson
Head of Tech Procurement, Acme Retail

[attachment: procurement_requirements_acme.pdf (PDF, 45 KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Internal — approvals needed for Acme MAP/SOW

Team — quick internal note to align before we send SOC2 and the DocuSign envelope:

- Legal (Karthik) to confirm acceptance of any minor SOW redlines; flag anything material that requires exec sign-off.
- Security (Monica) to provide the SOC2 one-pager and the artifact link; confirm data retention and encryption language maps to our standard language.
- Finance (Marissa) to confirm invoice cadence; we can accept monthly billing for pilot but need to confirm if PO is acceptable in place of SOW signature.

I recommend we aim for an exec approval sync on Nov 5 (15-minute slot) so Dylan can confirm final go/no-go to Acme that afternoon. If legal needs more time and asks for edits past Nov 7, we should push the sign window to Nov 10–12 and move start to Nov 22 to allow onboarding.

I'll draft the outbound note once we have SOC2 and finance confirmation.

—Marissa
Director, Customer Success (on the thread for onboarding sequencing)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jill Thompson <jill.thompson@acmeretail.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Final MAP & signoff window for pilot + start date

Hi Jill — confirming next steps and updated windows after internal review: 

- We can accept a signed PO in lieu of immediate SOW signature for access provisioning and billing. Finance confirms monthly invoicing for pilot is fine.
- Monica attached a SOC2 one-pager (SOC2_summary.pdf) and will provide the full artifact link to your legal team.
- Legal (Karthik) reviewed the SOW; no material governance changes expected, just two small clarifications which I'll implement in SOW_v1.4 before DocuSign.

Updated timeline proposal: DocuSign envelope live Nov 10 (to allow legal changes to be merged), signature window Nov 10–12. If signed in that window, our earliest realistic start date is Nov 22 to allow onboarding and infra prep.

I'll push the DocuSign envelope once I upload the final SOW (SOW_Redwood_v1.4.docx). For traceability, here's our HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-2026-042.

Dylan

[attachment: SOC2_summary.pdf (PDF, 58 KB)]

From: Jill Thompson <jill.thompson@acmeretail.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeretail.com>, Acme Retail Legal <legal@acmeretail.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Final MAP & signoff window for pilot + start date

Dylan / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement will issue a PO and Acme legal is comfortable with the two clarifications you noted. We will sign via DocuSign during Nov 11 (internal approvals on Nov 10).

Confirming: PO attached now (PO_ACME_4532.pdf). Requested start date Nov 22 works for our onboarding calendar. Please send the final access checklist and kickoff invite once the envelope is complete.

Jill

[attachment: PO_ACME_4532.pdf (PDF, 64 KB)]
summary: Finalization thread for Acme Retail MAP and SOW. Internal alignment on SOC2, finance billing, and legal redlines led to adjusted DocuSign window (Nov 10–12) and confirmed start date Nov 22 after PO/signature.
